record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: For every shift-monotone sequence ideal z(N0), let L^{APP}_z be the ideal defined from dyadic approximation numbers and let L^{ENT}_z be the ideal defined from dyadic entropy numbers. Show that L^{APP}_z is contained in L^{ENT}_z for all shift-monotone sequence ideals z(N0).

evidence.quote:
Problem 17. Show that LAPP
z ⊆ LENT
z for all shift-monotone sequence
ideals.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $\mathcal{L}$ denote the class of all bounded linear operators acting between arbitrary Banach spaces. For an operator $T:X\to Y$ between Banach spaces, define:

- The $n$-th approximation number $a_n(T) = \inf\{\|T-A\| : A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y),\ \mathrm{rank}(A)<n\}$ for $n\in\mathbb{N}$.
- The $n$-th (dyadic) entropy number $e_n(T) = \inf\{\varepsilon>0 : T(B_X)\ \text{can be covered by}\ 2^{n-1}\ \text{balls of radius}\ \varepsilon\ \text{in}\ Y\}$ for $n\in\mathbb{N}$.

Set the dyadic versions $a_n^{\mathrm{dy}}(T) = a_{2^{n}}(T)$ and $e_n^{\mathrm{dy}}(T) = e_{2^{n}}(T)$ for $n\in\mathbb{N}_0$.

Sequence ideals. Let $\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$ denote the linear space of bounded scalar sequences indexed by $\mathbb{N}_0$. A subspace $z(\mathbb{N}_0)\subseteq\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is called a sequence ideal if it is solid (i.e. $|s_n|\le|t_n|$ for all $n$ and $(t_n)\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ imply $(s_n)\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$). It is called shift-monotone if it is closed under both the left and right shift operators: $(s_0,s_1,s_2,\dots)\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ if and only if $(s_1,s_2,\dots)\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, and $(0,s_0,s_1,\dots)\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ for all $(s_n)\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$.

Operator ideals generated by sequence ideals. For a shift-monotone sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, define the operator classes
$$L^{\mathrm{APP}}_{z} = \{\,T\in\mathcal{L} : (a_n^{\mathrm{dy}}(T))_{n\ge 0}\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)\,\},$$
$$L^{\mathrm{ENT}}_{z} = \{\,T\in\mathcal{L} : (e_n^{\mathrm{dy}}(T))_{n\ge 0}\in z(\mathbb{N}_0)\,\}.$$

Problem. Prove that $L^{\mathrm{APP}}_{z}\subseteq L^{\mathrm{ENT}}_{z}$ for every shift-monotone sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a list of open questions on traces and operator ideals over the class of all Banach spaces. Web searches did not surface a published proof or counterexample establishing the inclusion $L^{\mathrm{APP}}_z\subseteq L^{\mathrm{ENT}}_z$ for arbitrary shift-monotone sequence ideals; related work (e.g., comparisons of entropy and approximation numbers) addresses specific scales but not the full general statement. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Modern Applications of s-numbers and Operator Ideals
status_evidence.snippet: Pietsch presented an overview of important open problems concerning s-numbers and operator ideals.
status_evidence.claim: Comparisons between approximation- and entropy-generated ideals appear among Pietsch's open problems.

status_evidence.title: Approximation of Entropy Numbers (arXiv:1703.01418)
status_evidence.snippet: Comparisons between approximation numbers and entropy numbers are studied for specific classes of operators.
status_evidence.claim: General inclusion of approximation- vs entropy-generated ideals is not established in the literature for all shift-monotone sequence ideals.
